Yes—paper [1] is the match: it is by Woosung Koh and focuses on “Continually Post-training Small Models via Synthetic Self-distillation.” It says standard self-distillation fails on smaller models, and proposes Synthetic Self-Distillation (SynthSelf) to provide high-quality supervision for small models without breaking their original distribution. [1]

If you meant a different self-distillation paper, [2] is also related but it targets diffusion language models rather than small continual post-training, and [8] is about verifier-guided distillation for small language models rather than synthetic self-distillation. [2, 8]
